meta.title: Video Subtitle Downloader
meta.description: Fetch a Bilibili video's subtitles into a local subtitle file. Restart the desktop app once and a “Video Subtitle” page shows up in Settings: scan a QR code with the Bilibili app and you are logged in; the official subtitle API then usually answers in under a second. When official subtitles are not available, two local engines can transcribe the audio on your own machine: Whisper and SenseVoice. SenseVoice is faster but cuts sentences shorter; both work offline with no usage limit, and one button on the page installs whatever is missing, showing the progress step by step. Can fetch many videos or every 分P of a collection in one call, and can merge fragment subtitles into readable sentences plus a plain transcript. Returns only metadata (title, duration, character counts, file paths) — the transcript itself is read on demand by time range.
